newsitem.title: PERU: Peru requests entry to U.S. debt-reduction program.
newsitem.headline: Peru requests entry to U.S. debt-reduction program.

text.p: Peru has asked the United States for eligibility to join its program of voluntary reduction of concessional debt to Latin American nations, the state news agency Andina reported Wednesday.
Andina said the Peruvian government submitted the request to the U.S. Treasury authorites and the State Department Tuesday.
If accepted to the U.S. program, Peru could have its soft loans forgiven or allowed to be used for ecological projects or social programs.

Peru's Prime Minister and Minister for Mines Alberto Pandolfi and Economy Minister Jorge Camet are currently in Washington meeting with International Monetary Fund officials and other multi-lateral lending institutions in an effort to restructure the country's foreign debt.
